1378. 3. April. Rrumau — Nikolaus genannt Plachta von Payreschau teeist Keiner Gemahlin Katherina von Kuchlitz 6S Talente zu Widerlage auf seinen Gütern in Payreschau an. 1378. 21. April. 0. �?0. — Die Brüder Peter und Johann von Rosenberg erlassen

CLII. Ego Nicolaus dictus Plachta de Barssow tenore presencium recognosco vniuersis, quia Nicolaus filius Peraslini de Chuchlecz pro dotalicio sororis sue vxoris mee Katherine michi viginti quinque talenta denariorum Vyennensium asignauit. Ego vero prefate con- thorali mee Katherine in omnibus bonis meis mobilibus et immobilibus que ibidem in Barsszow babeo, sexaginta quinque talenta veri dota- licii dedi et asignaui preter mediam sexagenam redituum, quam in eadem villa Barsszow super villano meo, qui Szratlinus dicitur, Gyte sorori mee prius tradidi et deputaui; alia vero omnia bona mea mobilia et inmobilia in villa mea Har.sszow vxori mee pretacte do et asigno litteram per presentem, etiamsi valor eorumdem bonorum et rerum excederet taxam sexaginta quinque talentorum Vyennensis et Patauiensis monete denariorum, omne jus, quod in ipsis bonis et rebus babui, in ipsam Margaretham conthoralem meam transferendo, tali tamen sub condicione, quod si mee heredes legittimos contin- geret generare, tune ipsa conthoralis mea solum sexaginta quinque talenta in hereditatibus meis sepetactis obtinebit, reliquum vero quidquid habeo uel babuero, ad ipsos pneros meos omni absque con 176 trouersia et lite pertinebit. In cuius rei euidenciam et roboramenfum sigillum meum presentibus duxi appendendum et pro maiori testi monio ad peticionem meam sigilla discretorum virorum Vlrici dicti Drochouecz de Omleuiczka et Johannis dicti Zizka de Trucznow presentibus sunt appensa. Datum Chrumphnaw sabato ante domini cana „Judica" anuo domini millesimo trecentesimo septuagesimo octauo. Drei kleine, an Pergamentstreifen bangende Siegel in weissem Wachs. — a) Ein Helm mit dem Brustbilde eines schwertschwingenden Mannes. — f- S. Mikes . Pliega . z . Barosowicz. b) Ein Helm mit Hut, daran zwei Hörner. — f S . Vlrici . De . [Omlenicz?]. e) Ein Schild, worauf ein Fisch. — Millauer sieht in diesem Zeichen einen Krebs — darüber ein Helm mit demselben Zeichen zum Schmucke. — f S . Johanis . D . Tr . . . ov. Dieses Siegel ¡st leider schlecht abgedruckt. СЫ�?. 1378. 21. April. 0. �?0. — Die Brüder Peter und Johann von Rosenberg erlassen dem Abte Otto und dem Convente des Stiftes Hohenfurt von dessen Eigen in Liebenthal die Lehenspflicht. Nos Petrus et Jobannes de Rosenbergh tenore presencium constare volvmus vniuersis, quod cvm nobis per honorabilem domi- num Ottonem abbatem ac religiosos fratres couuentus monasterü nostri Altiuadensis pie propter deum foret supplicatum, quatenus hereditatem, quam a Benesio de Quassow in villa Lyebintail com- parauerunt, in qua tres homines eorum censuales resident, qui ipsis pro censibus ac aliis juribus vniuersis tria talenta cum tribus solidis et sedecim denariis denariorum Wienensium de eisdem hereditatibus soluere obligantur, a omagio wlgariter leben dicto, quod nobis in eadem villa competere dinoscitur, suportare dignaremur et libertare, vt eo obligaciores se pro nostris nostrorumque predecessorum ani- mabus aput deum omnipotentum exhiberent interpellatores; asseren- tes nichilominus se super tali libertacione hereditatis antedicte nostram antea litteram habuisse rohoracionis eamque per dominum Vlricum fratrem nostrum cassatam extitisse ac demum omnimodo perdidisse nobisque precibus intimis humiliter supplicantes, vt ean- dem gratiam libertarionis antedicte hereditatis ab ipso omagio diuine remuneracionis ob respectum restaurare dignaremur gratiose. Nos igitur amore dei omnipotentis eorum precibus inclinati ac per hoc cull um diuinum augmentare cupientes sepetactam hereditatem mo 177 nasterii Altiuadensis antedicti in prefata villa Lyebintayl ab onera- cione omagii prelibati onmimode liberam reddimus et sulutam dantes ei in testimonium presens scriptum sigillorum nostrorum appensione munitum. Sub anno domini millesimo trecentesimo septuagesimo octauo feria quarta ante festum sancti Jeorii martins gloriosi. Über die Siegel siehe CIV und CXIV.
entries.english:
The source transcription contains two notices.

3 April 1378, Krumlov — Nikolaus called Plachta von Payreschau assigns his wife Katherina von Kuchlitz 65 talents as her dowry, secured on his properties at Payreschau.

I, Nikolaus called Plachta de Barssow, make known to all by this document that Nicolaus, son of Peraslinus de Chuchlecz, assigned me 25 talents of Viennese denarii as the dowry of his sister, my wife Katherine. I have given and assigned to my aforesaid wife Katherine, as her dowry, 65 talents in all my movable and immovable property that I have at Barsszow, in addition to half a sexagena of revenue in the same village at my tenant named Szratlinus, which I previously gave and assigned to my sister Gita. By this document I give and assign to my aforesaid wife all my other movable and immovable property in my village Har.sszow, transferring to her every right I had in those goods and properties, even if their value exceeds the assessment of 65 talents in Viennese and Patawian coin. However, if I should have legitimate heirs, my wife shall receive only 65 talents from the aforesaid inheritances; all the rest of whatever I have or may have shall belong to my children without dispute or litigation. In confirmation of this matter I attach my seal; at my request the seals of the prudent men Ulricus called Drochouecz de Omleuiczka and Johannes called Zizka de Trucznow are attached as further testimony. Given at Krumlov on the Saturday before the Sunday ‘Judica’, in the year of the Lord 1378.

Three small seals hang from parchment strips in white wax. The first shows a helmet with the bust of a man wielding a sword, with the inscription ‘S. Mikes Pliega z Barosowicz’. The second shows a helmet with a hat and two horns: ‘S. Vlrici De [Omlenicz?]’. The third bears a shield with a fish, which Millauer considers a crab, above which is a helmet with the same device as its crest; the inscription is unfortunately poorly impressed: ‘S. Johanis D. Tr…’.

21 April 1378 — The brothers Peter and Johann von Rosenberg release Abbot Otto and the convent of Hohenfurt Abbey from the feudal obligation on their freehold at Liebenthal.

We, Peter and Johann von Rosenberg, make known to all by this document that the honorable Lord Otto, abbot, and the religious brothers of the convent of our monastery of Hohenfurt devoutly petitioned us, for God’s sake, to release and free from homage, commonly called ‘Lehen’, the inheritance they purchased from Benes de Quassow in the village of Liebenthal, where three of their rent-paying tenants reside, who are bound to pay them from those properties three talents, three solidi, and sixteen Viennese denarii in rents and other dues. This would make them more obligated to intercede with Almighty God for the souls of us and our predecessors. They further stated that they had previously held our charter confirming such release, but that our brother Ulric had annulled it and it had since been entirely lost; they humbly and earnestly petitioned us to restore this release of the aforesaid inheritance from that homage, out of regard for divine reward. We, moved by love of Almighty God and inclined to their petition, desiring thereby to increase divine worship, declare the aforesaid inheritance of the said monastery at Liebenthal entirely free and released from the aforesaid burden of homage. This document is given in testimony, secured by the attachment of our seals. Given in the year of the Lord 1378, on the Wednesday before the feast of the glorious martyr St George.

See nos. CIV and CXIV for the seals.
